map.RAW 文件大小估算 使用指南: RAW File Size Estimator User Guide
map.RAW 文件大小估算工具按像素与位深估算单张 RAW 体积与连续拍摄时长占用空间: The RAW file size estimator computes the volume of one RAW frame from pixel count and bit depth, plus the space used by burst shooting, for planning memory cards, drive capacity and backup cards.
map.由像素与位深算单张 RAW MB。: Single RAW frame size in MB from pixels and bit depth.
map.估视频/连拍缓冲占用。: Estimates video or burst buffer usage.
map.：24MP、14bit：RAW = 24e6×14/8/1e6 ≈ 42MB/张: 24MP, 14-bit: RAW = 24e6*14/8/1e6 = about 42MB per frame; at 10fps burst the buffer needs about 420MB per second, so a high-speed card is required.
map.：同参数 @10fps 录 60s：42×10×60/1000 ≈ 25.2GB: With the same settings at 10fps for 60s: 42*10*60/1000 = about 25.2GB. RAW video is very storage-hungry, so compressed proxies are normally used.
map.RAW 比 JPEG 大多少？: How Much Bigger Is RAW Than JPEG?
map.约 3–8 倍，因含全部拜耳数据与元数据；位深 14bit 比 12bit 多: About 3-8x, because it contains all Bayer data plus metadata; 14-bit is 17% larger than 12-bit.
map.为什么连拍看卡速？: Why Does Burst Shooting Depend on Card Speed?
map.每秒数百 MB 写入，低速卡迅速填满缓冲停拍，需 V90/UHS-II 级。: It writes hundreds of MB per second, so a slow card fills the buffer and stops burst shooting quickly; V90/UHS-II class is required.
